?Neutral Citation No. - 2023:Ahc:105737
Court No. - 82
Case :- Criminal Misc Anticipatory Bail Application U/S 438 Cr.P.C. No. - 4800 of 2023
Applicant :- Dr. Mohit Bindal

Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another Counsel for Applicant :- Chandra Bhushan Prasad Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Prabhakar Tripathi Hon'ble Subhash Chandra Sharma,J.
Heard learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the material placed on record.

This anticipatory bail application (under section 438 Cr.P.C.) has been moved seeking bail in Case Crime No.318 of 2022, under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506, 376, 511 I.P.C. & Section 3/4 Dowry Prohibition Act-1961, Police Station Mahila Thana, District Muzaffar Nagar, during the pendency of investigation.
It is submitted by learned counsel for the applicant that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case.
No offence is made out from the allegation made against him.

It is also submitted that since the offences said to have been committed are punishable with Dr. Mohit Bindal vs State Of U.P. And Another on 16 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/154925213/
1 sentence less than 7 years, therefore, a direction be given to learned trial court to make disposal of the bail application in light of the Satender Antil's case.

entities.text: Dr. Mohit Bindal vs State Of U.P. And Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned A.G.A. opposed the prayer as aforesaid.

Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, submissions made by learned counsel for the applicant as well as learned A.G.A. and perusal of record, it is directed that, if applicant appears and moves bail application before the learned court concerned within a period of 30 days from today, the same shall be decided by it as expeditiously as possible in the light of latest law as laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another LL 2022 SC 577 decided on 11.07.2022.
